obligations.statement: The clamp must fix a monitor arm to the edge of a desk.
derivation_premises: The requirement demands that the clamp holds the arm in place on the desk edge.

obligations.statement: The clamp must accommodate desk edges with thickness between 18 and 40 mm.
derivation_premises: The requirement specifies a range of desk thicknesses.

obligations.statement: The clamp must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm when tight.
derivation_premises: The requirement states that the clamp must stay fixed under load.

obligations.statement: The clamp must be removable and movable to another desk without any tools.
